answer: The forge schedule is applied in meadow and zenith publishes each instalment. Someone therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and therefore 44% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4083 identities would post 2303 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
